name: Zoho Cliq
description: Zoho Cliq is a team collaboration and messaging application offering chat, channels, bots, and productivity automation tools.

evidence.claim: Zoho Cliq API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication.
The Zoho Cliq MCP Server brings your chats into the world of AI using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
v3 introduces CRUD API endpoints for bots, slash commands, message actions, widgets, schedulers, and more.

notes: Zoho Cliq has comprehensive REST APIs (v2 and v3) covering messages, chats, bots, webhooks, and platform components, alongside official support for Model Context Protocol (MCP).
